I had a similar experience this morning. I queued as a tank on my pally (he’s ret normally but I know how to play prot and his gear is way, way beyond adequate).

It was mana tombs, so I was chain-pulling at a good clip but I was only going through one group at a time because multiple groups of mobs in mana tombs is when people start getting stun locked, feared into even more groups of mobs etc. It’s just bad news and leads to wipes.

Well it wasn’t good enough, so as a pushy healer starts pulling mobs ahead of me. I politely asked them to stop. My exact words “Please don’t pull for me.” Note: The group did not ask me to pull more, didn’t even say “hurry up”. It was just pulling mobs onto me to whip me to go faster.

I was told by the healer that he would continue to pull mobs if I continued with the dungeon the way I had been. So I initiated a votekick on him, which failed (I wasn’t surprised it failed but I felt it should be up to the group how to proceed). A DPS then told me that the dungeon run would take “3 hours”.

Love the hyperbole, we were almost done with the dungeon by that point. It had been like 10 minutes, probably less. So I just left the group, didn’t wait for the kick but also wasn’t going to put up with being whipped through the dungeon by impatient people.

If you want to go super fast and pull whole rooms, you need to queue as tank. Dear healers: Stop trying to set the pace. Just freaking stop, it’s not your job, you know it’s not your job. If the tank isn’t meeting your standards, use your words. If that doesn’t work kick the tank. Do not just start pulling. It is rude and it is so incredibly not your role as healer to do it.

If that’s how it went, good for them. More power to them.

posts.name: Xanril
posts.cooked:
Akio:

there would be more tanks in queues and shorter waits if people let tanks play according to their playstyle

Well I guess, but on the other hand, if every single pull feels like it’d be a waste of cooldowns, then the entire run feels bad because you aren’t getting to play the way your spec is designed to be played.

A tank’s playstyle needs to consider the game design as well. We don’t need to be playing like we’re trying practicing for MDI, but if DPS don’t get to use their cooldowns or they use them on one pack and then the tank stops to respond to their group text chat before pulling the next and the CDs fall off, you’re left in a situation where the run is less fulfilling than being in the queue.

Just because it’s BC Timewalking doesn’t mean we need to revert to BC dungeon tactics. The game’s not designed like that anymore.

I do think it could have been discussed, but not by just pulling for me and then telling me off when I asked the guy to stop doing that. There comes a point where it’s past discussion I guess. posts.name: Galabris
posts.cooked:
It depends on the dungeon and smart tanks know this. Mana Tombs? You respect the priests and don’t pull 5+ packs with them. Fear mobs? You don’t pull double rooms with them. Even if the heals isn’t unsurmountable (it is with pugtard DPS), the silences will wreck you and getting feared with a pile of enemies getting free backshots can wreck you.

But most dungeons are boring babymode easy to do big pulls. Timid coward tanks take what should be a 5 minute romp and turn it into a 10+ minute ordeal. The ultra bad/lazy pulling 1 pack at a time practically gimps any DPS spec especially for a right of bell curve trying to line up CDs with an expected big pull to maximize value. I don’t vote kick or vote along with people unless they’re intentionally doing stupid stuff, but it’s still frustrating as hell when you just want some quick XP and you get into one of “those” runs.
